page.title: Learning home
page.description: Continue your current lesson, review what needs attention, and return to recently used content.

continueLearning.title: Continue learning
continueLearning.description: Return to the exact lesson and content you were following.

pulse.title: Learning pulse
pulse.description: Signals that need attention in your current progress.
pulse.tracked: {count} items have a learning status. The first group contains items being learned or marked difficult; it is not the SRS due schedule.
pulse.empty: There is no progress to summarize yet. Start learning or mark a status and the dashboard will update automatically.
pulse.unavailable: The SRS, Learning Loop, and Reader overview could not be loaded. Current learning progress is still shown.

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.description: Items you recently reviewed and their recorded results.
activity.empty: No recent reviews yet. Activity will appear here after you grade a flashcard.

notes.title: Recently updated notes
notes.description: Continue the notes you used recently.
